title: One cancellation decreases the total rank of a bounded free resolution
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], M an R-module and P an augmented projective resolution of M [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension; def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] with finite free terms [def-weil-finitely-generated-module; def-weil-pbc-free-module], zero above a natural degree d. Suppose not every differential from degree i+1 to i, for i<d, has image in the maximal ideal times P_i. Then there is another augmented projective resolution P′ of M, finite free and zero above d, whose sum of Module.finrank R over degrees 0 through d is strictly smaller than that of P. No minimality is asserted for P′.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00MT, applied in the proof of Tag 00OA to remove trivial summands

proof.text: Choose finite bases. If all differential coefficients lie in the maximal ideal, expansion in the source basis proves the excluded containment. Thus some coefficient is a unit. Extend by zero to integer degrees and apply the unit-entry splitting theorem.

Restrict the complementary complex back to natural degrees. Its augmentation is the restriction of the original augmentation, which annihilates the removed identity summand. The contractible identity summand contributes no homology; hence the complement remains an augmented exact projective resolution. Its terms are finite free and zero above d.
The two affected finite ranks each decrease by one; all other ranks agree. Both affected degrees occur in Fin(d+1), so the displayed total rank strictly decreases.

theorem bounded_resolution_cancellation_decreases_rank {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R)
    (d : ℕ) (P : ProjectiveResolution M)
    (hzero : ∀ i : ℕ, d < i → IsZero (P.complex.X i))
    (hfree : ∀ i : ℕ, Module.Finite R (P.complex.X i) ∧ Module.Free R (P.complex.X i))
    (hnot : ¬ ∀ i : ℕ, i < d →
      LinearMap.range (P.complex.d (i + 1) i).hom ≤
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R (P.complex.X i))) :
    ∃ P' : ProjectiveResolution M,
      (∀ i : ℕ, d < i → IsZero (P'.complex.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, Module.Finite R (P'.complex.X i) ∧ Module.Free R (P'.complex.X i)) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin (d + 1), Module.finrank R (P'.complex.X i.val)) <
        ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), Module.finrank R (P.complex.X i.val)
